title: pst
tagline: We are building an in-browser address-to-addres messaging service that you can access within a browser extension.
description:
Discord and other non-crypto native social platforms like Twitter and Reddit are placeholder tools that do not meet the needs of the crypto community. We saw this in the last bull market where NFT communities were forced to discord, and hacks, scams, rugs, and phishing attempts flourished. For ethereum to scale, it needs better social tools. pst is the first step towards building a crypto-native social platform. We do this by meeting our users where they are, not by asking them to change their UX patterns. pst is a browser extension that gives you an inbox tied to any ethereum address/ens, compatible with any web3 wallet.  

Messages are encrypted to the recipients public key, allowing you to share private messages publicly, without having to worry about the wrong user gaining access to your private message. Our product is for any user that has ever wanted to reach out to someone on chain, and never had the tools to do so. Maybe you noticed a large CDP close to liquidation and wanted to chat with the holder directly, maybe you saw a Bored Ape and wanted to place a bid with the owner privately. Our product is for you, and its for the entire scaling ethereum community.
